metadata.title: FFT AI Edition – Session Trace Schema (v1.3)
metadata.subtitle: Measures • Paradox • Consent • RTT • Collapse • Lineage
metadata.description: Defines the authoritative schema and trace envelope for RTT transitions in FFT AI Edition v1.3.

status_line: Session traces MUST record RTT node transitions, measure IDs, paradox events, consent state, substrate class, lineage, and collapse.

field_definitions.substrate_class: One of: agentic, parametric, symbolic, edge.
field_definitions.steps: Ordered list of RTT node transitions.

field_definitions.operator: Operator executed at this RTT node.
field_definitions.paradox_events: List of typed paradox events or empty list.
field_definitions.collapse_state: null unless RTT12; MUST be 'collapsed' at RTT12.

measure_rules: All measures MUST be numeric in [0,1].
Every threshold MUST cite a measure ID.
paradox_rules: RTT7 entry requires a typed paradox event.
Paradox MUST be one of the canonical types.
substrate_rules: Non-agentic substrate forbidden for harmonic and resolution.
rtt_rules: RTT nodes MUST map to frozen RTT v0.9 quantities.
